finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can manipulate the content of the 'secret' file to inject arbitrary commands.
finding.assumptions: The file './secret' is writable by an attacker and contains the password in plain text.

finding.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a malicious email address with embedded script tags.
finding.assumptions: The email content is displayed in a web application without proper sanitization.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.untrusted_source: Hard-coded SMTP server URL and username
finding.trigger: An attacker can exploit the hard-coded credentials if the SMTP server allows command injection.
finding.assumptions: The SMTP server configuration allows command injection through the URL or username.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a malicious email address that includes command injection payloads.
finding.assumptions: The SMTP server configuration allows command injection through the recipient list.
